changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_id_seq_heal(bigint): a SECURITY DEFINER function, search_path pinned, that draws the collection_id sequence forward to a floor (the larger of the caller's and the largest collection_id of any tenant, read through D2's owner-read policy) with nextval (never setval, at most 100000 draws); nexus.collection_id_taken(bigint): a SECURITY DEFINER boolean over every tenant's collection_id, the same way; EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to nexus_svc, which holds no UPDATE on the sequence (RDR-229 P3.8). DATA EFFECT: none; two function definitions and their privileges, no row written (the functions read when called, not at the changeset).
